copy.heading: Choose how your agents think
copy.body: Ronin helps you control your agents. It does not sit between you and your model providers.
Sign in with your own subscription or your own API key. The credential stays on this machine.
One working provider is enough to start. Add the others whenever you like.

media.label: Provider sign-in guide
media.description: How Ronin keeps credentials with you

copy.heading: Introduce yourself
copy.body: Local Ronin works whether you register or not. Share only what feels useful.

copy.heading: Choose a Workspace Folder
copy.body: A Workspace Folder is a place Ronin may work in.

copy.heading: Choose installations
copy.body: Installations add optional facilities while the core coworkspace stays local and lightweight.

copy.heading: Start one Agent
copy.body: Give the Agent a clear objective and keep the first piece of work small.
